_comment: Unofficial Moon Sweepers server egg for Pelican and Pterodactyl. See PELICAN.md.
name: Moon Sweepers (unofficial)
author: 49323721+JustPita@users.noreply.github.com
description: Unofficial CPU-only Moon Sweepers host: runs your owned Windows game with Wine and the anonymous Steam GameServer API. Players join with the server Steam ID and password through Steam P2P/relay; no port forwarding and no Steam login are needed. Upload your own game files into game/ before the first start.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Moon Sweepers is a paid game without a dedicated server depot, so the
# owner uploads their own installation. Nothing is downloaded here.
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server/game
cat > /mnt/server/UPLOAD-GAME-FILES.txt <<'EOF'
Upload your own Moon Sweepers installation into the game/ directory.

Copy the CONTENTS of steamapps/common/Moon Sweepers (MoonSweepers.exe,
GameAssembly.dll, UnityPlayer.dll, MoonSweepers_Data, D3D12, ...) so that
game/MoonSweepers.exe exists, for example with an SFTP client.

The server checks the game build at every start. The game version must
be supported by the server module and match the version of the players.
EOF
echo "Installation complete. Upload the game files into game/ before starting."

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: Shared join password asked by the game when a player connects (8-128 printable ASCII characters). The server refuses to start with the default value.

variables.name: Allowed SteamIDs
variables.description: Optional comma-separated list of up to 15 SteamID64s. Empty allows every licensed player who knows the password.

variables.name: Steam server token
variables.description: Optional Game Server Login Token for app 5335510 (create it at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers). With a token the server keeps the same Steam ID after restarts; empty uses a new anonymous Steam ID at every start.

variables.name: Save slot
variables.description: Game save slot (1-5) hosted by the server.

variables.name: Backups kept
variables.description: Number of automatic world backups (backups/) kept after each clean stop.
